name: MyFitnessPal
why: Largest nutrition logger with an App Gallery of device partners; its help center lists 'Total Energy Partners' (Fitbit/Google Health, Garmin Connect, Withings, Polar, Samsung Health, Google Fit, Health Connect, Apple Watch) and its developer portal invites developers of 'apps, devices, and services' to apply for its private API. No overnight HRV/recovery band is listed among those partners.
ask: Request API documentation and partner terms via the developer portal contact (API@myfitnesspal.com, as published) to scope a device integration.
opener: Hi MyFitnessPal API team, I'm building Vybe Health, a screenless band worn overnight that captures ECG-based HRV and sleep timing for general wellness. Your developer portal invites devices to apply, so I'd like to explore how Vybe could become a data source in your App Gallery, so members can see last night's rest next to what they logged. Could you share the current API docs and partner process?
opportunity: Apply to the private MyFitnessPal API as a device partner so Vybe overnight recovery/sleep context appears alongside food logs (Nourish x Restore); near-term, Vybe data reaching MFP via Health Connect/Apple Health, which MFP already reads.
unknowns: Whether MFP's API accepts sleep/HRV data types (published categories are weight, workouts, steps/energy, glucose); approval criteria and any partner fee unknown; no named partnerships lead found.

name: PlateLens
why: AI photo calorie tracker (iOS, Android, Apple Watch, web) whose site says it syncs with Apple Health and Google Health Connect and that its AI coach uses steps, activity and weight data; it also runs a read-only MCP server exposing activity data. An independent review (updated 2026-10-01) reports Garmin Connect, Whoop and Oura syncing in testing, so it already courts wearable users.
why_now: Review Bench review last updated 2026-10-01; PlateLens MCP server live.
warm_path: Caplight lists Y Combinator as an investor (search snippet only, not opened)
ask: 15-minute call on adding overnight recovery/sleep context to the coach, starting with Vybe writing to Apple Health / Health Connect.
opener: Hi PlateLens team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health, a screenless overnight band (ECG-based HRV, sleep timing) with a licensed SDK. Your coach already reads activity and weight via Apple Health and Health Connect. I'd like to explore giving it last night's rest as context too, so nutrition guidance can reflect how someone slept. Open to a 15-minute call?
opportunity: Vybe data enters PlateLens via Apple Health / Health Connect, which it already reads; next step a direct integration so the AI coach adds sleep/HRV context to its nutrition advice (Nourish x Restore).
unknowns: PlateLens's own pages list only Apple Health / Health Connect; the Garmin/Whoop/Oura sync is from a third-party review, not the company. Whether it reads sleep/HRV from Apple Health is unconfirmed. No partnerships contact; only support@platelens.app is published.

name: Alma: Nutrition Coach
why: AI nutrition coach (Menlo Ventures-backed per its Feb 2025 launch release) whose App Store listing says it connects Apple Health and supported wearables to bring 'food, movement, sleep, workouts' together, and it supports sleep goals. Its help center says Garmin, Oura and WHOOP connect through Apple Health, so it is device-agnostic.
why_now: App Store listing shows an active release cadence (TrainingPeaks nutrition sync, Apple Health background updates).
ask: Ask whether the Coach reads Apple Health sleep/HRV today and whether they'd test a Vybe DevKit as a design partner.
opener: Hi Alma team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health, a screenless band worn overnight with a licensed SDK. Your help center says Garmin, Oura and WHOOP reach Alma through Apple Health, and you support sleep goals. Vybe writes overnight data to Apple Health too. Would you be open to a short call about including last night's rest in Coach context, and possibly trying our DevKit?
opportunity: Zero-build path: Vybe writes sleep/HRV to HealthKit and Alma's Coach can read it like Oura/WHOOP; co-market a 'sleep + nutrition' view (Nourish x Restore) and invite Alma as a DevKit design partner.
unknowns: Which Apple Health categories Alma reads (sleep confirmed in listing; HRV not); iOS only; no public partnerships contact (developers page did not load); funding stage beyond launch release unknown.

name: WeightWatchers
why: WW's own app guide lists compatible sources: Apple Health, Garmin, Fitbit, Google Fit and Health Connect. WW calls its program 'food, activity, mindset and sleep' and in 2021 brought in Breethe as an outside content partner for mindset, so it has partnered with smaller wellness brands before.
ask: Intro to WW's partnerships/product team to ask whether sleep data from Health Connect/Apple Health is on their roadmap and whether a small pilot is possible.
opener: Hi, I'm the founder of Vybe Health, a screenless band worn overnight with an SDK that writes to Apple Health and Health Connect, both of which WeightWatchers already supports. Sleep is one of your program pillars, so I'd value 15 minutes with whoever owns device integrations to see whether overnight rest data could be useful to members.
opportunity: Vybe reaches WW members through Apple Health / Health Connect, which WW already supports; pitch overnight sleep context for the program's sleep pillar (Restore), building on WW's precedent of bringing in outside wellness partners (Breethe 2021).
unknowns: The guide shows WW uses device data for activity Points; no evidence it ingests sleep. WW allows only one connected device at a time. No public partner/BD contact found; large-company decision process; 2025 corporate restructuring not researched.

name: Breethe
why: Sleep and meditation app (18M+ downloads per Kodeon) that writes Mindful Minutes to Apple Health. It was acquired 2026-08-19 by Kodeon, whose co-founder said 'Imagine your fitness app knowing you slept badly and adjusting tomorrow's workout', a cross-app sleep-data idea that fits an overnight band. Breethe has run B2B content partnerships (WW 2021, ClassPass 2023) and keeps partnership landing pages (e.g. /partnerships/iin).
why_now: Kodeon acquisition announced 2026-08-19, with 'further announcements planned in the months ahead'.
ask: 15-minute call with Kodeon on piloting overnight sleep timing as a signal that personalizes Breethe's wind-down recommendations.
opener: Hi Jon, I read the Breethe announcement, especially your point about apps knowing when someone slept badly. I'm building Vybe Health, a screenless band worn overnight with a licensed SDK that captures sleep timing and HRV for general wellness. That could be one input to Breethe's recommendations. Would you be open to a 15-minute call about a small pilot?
opportunity: Restore factor: Vybe's overnight data could personalize Breethe's sleep content (e.g. a wind-down suggestion after a short night), plus co-marketing to Breethe's sleep audience; pitch to Kodeon while it integrates Breethe into its 'AppLife' ecosystem.
unknowns: Breethe's App Store listing confirms only Mindful Minutes written to Apple Health, with no wearable data read in. Kodeon's integration roadmap is not public. The only published contact is a media address (mediarelations@kodeon.ai); no BD contact.

name: Bathhouse
why: NYC 'social wellness' sauna and cold-plunge venues (Flatiron, Williamsburg, Atlantic Ave) with a public brand-partnership form. Recent recovery-positioned deals include NY Liberty (2026-09-23), Cove Circle's 'Official NYC Recovery & Wellness Partner' (2026-06) and a Superior Saunas mobile sauna at the NYU Langone HYROX event (2026-07). Forbes reports expansion to LA, Chicago and Nashville.
warm_path: HYROX community (Bathhouse activated at NYU Langone HYROX NYC)
ask: Submit a partnership request proposing a small member pilot: guests wear a Vybe band for two weeks and see their own overnight data after sauna days, as content, not claims.
opener: Hi Bathhouse team, I'm the founder of Vybe Health, a screenless band worn overnight that records sleep timing and HRV for general wellness. Your guests already care about recovery, and many are curious what their night looks like after a sauna session. Would you consider a small pilot where a few members wear Vybe and share what they notice? Happy to supply bands.
opportunity: Co-marketing pilot (Restore factor): seed bands to members or staff and make 'my night after the sauna' content; HYROX-event activations as a second channel. This is a venue partnership, not a data integration.
unknowns: Whether Bathhouse already has a wearable partner (none found, not confirmed); what its app/connector does; deal terms; any claim about sauna and sleep must be avoided.
